scenario: 300 sequential HTTP GET /echo requests through dynamically-configured Envoy (client -> envoy-dynamic:20000 -> backend-a::v1), single instance, local Docker Desktop on macOS arm64
notes: Sequential (not concurrent) client requests via curl; RPS figure reflects sequential round-trip throughput, not a concurrent load test. Concurrent load testing at scale is deferred to v0.9.0 per project plan.
